title: Q-DAGFlow: simulator, schedulers and experiment data for precision-guaranteed, queue-hedged co-scheduling of hybrid quantum-HPC AI workflows
description: Discrete-event simulator, scheduler implementations (Q-DAGFlow, six baselines and two strengthened baselines), calibration tables derived from public IBM device snapshots, validation scripts, numerical checks of the paper's lemmas and theorem, raw per-run results and analysis scripts. All performance results are simulation outputs produced on a single 2-vCPU Linux virtual machine; no physical quantum processor, computer cluster or GPU was used.
